host.title: Cube
host.description: IP address or hostname of the homee cube on the local network.

group.title: Group
group.description: Only expose devices in this homee group. Leave empty to expose everything supported.

impulse.title: Impulse-mode gates (node ids)
impulse.description: For operators that only react to one button (e.g. Hörmann via homee, where Open does nothing and Close toggles). Open and Close then send a single pulse, only when the gate is not already there.

deviceName.title: Device name
deviceName.description: How this bridge appears in the homee app's device list.
